title: AD was incorrect beware to consumers
text:
AD was incorrect beware to consumers. These replacement parts was recommended to go with the GTTVO BR150 robot vacuum cleaner. I trusted the ad and bought this along with my vacuum. I hadn’t had a chance to run my vacuum until last week and I never open the replacement box.
So I did today and the parts that were in there were NOT for my vacuum. I searched on line and found the manufacturer website left an email asking where to purchase the correct parts.

product_metadata.title: JJ Neumann Replacement Parts Accessories Compatible with Coredy Robot Vacuum Cleaner R3500/3500S,R650/R750 (R700),R600,Goovi 1600PA,XIEBro K10,iMartine C800/D900/900C,DEENKEE DK600,Bagotte BG600,
features: Compatibility - 100% compatible with Coredy Robot Vacuum Cleaner R3500, R3500S, R650, R750 (R700), R500+ (2nd Generation Dust Bin), R600 (2nd Generation Dust Bin), G800, Goovi D380, D382 (1600PA), GOOVI by ONSON F007C (Goovi 2000PA), J10C (Goovi 2100PA), iMartine C800, D900 D900C, DEENKEE DK600, Bagotte BG600, BG700, BG800, XIEBro K10. Do NOT fit Coredy R500+ / Bagotte 1st Generation Dust Bin. Please measure before buying!
Great Value - Include 6 pcs for heavy-duty side brushes and 6 pairs of filters. A free clean brush and a pair of disposable gloves are included for clean installation to protect your hands from dust.
Heavy Duty- Each brush and filter is hand picked to ensure the quality of the accessories.
Durability - JJ Neumann's side brushes are made from quality materials that can make our brushes last long. The hepa-style filters can effectively filter out dust, pollen, and other small particles.
Protective Package - They are shipped in a box with environmental friendly materials to keep replacement parts in good shape and ready to be used.
